title: Adventure Island
specs: Weather-or-Not Assurance covers return visits for inclement weather including rain, lightning, hail, extreme heat, wind, snow
Chaperone policy enforces safety for guests 17 and younger on select dates
Guests 17 or younger must be accompanied by a chaperone 21 or older on select dates and when chaperone policy is active
Chaperone must present valid government-issued photo ID with date of birth
One chaperone may accompany up to five guests aged 17 or younger
Proper swim attire required; no swimwear with buckles, rivets, or sharp objects allowed on slides
US Coast Guard approved life vests only
Group tickets available for groups of 15 to 99 online; groups 100+ contact by phone or email
Private events and park buyouts available by request

blurb: Guests enjoy water rides, slides, and tropical landscapes at Adventure Island. The park offers cabana and lounger rentals, group events, and an annual pass program with various benefits. The park has a chaperone policy for guests 17 and younger and a Weather-or-Not Assurance for inclement weather.

extraNote: Tickets, passes, memberships, and Fun Cards are nonrefundable, nontransferable, and revocable · Most in-park experiences and products may be rescheduled 1 or more times with no fee if rebooked 24-48 hours prior · Weather-or-Not Assurance provides a return visit if inclement weather causes early closure or ride closures over 60 minutes · Chaperone policy may be activated on select dates; guests 17 or younger must be accompanied by chaperone 21 or older · Adventure Island is a seasonal park
